title: Effective settings
description: What the deployment, tenant and user settings add up to for the caller (master plan 14.2), computed by the core with fixed rules and never by a model. Preferences take the most specific level that states them. Policy narrows from the top: voice, attachments and history export are on only when the deployment level allowed them and no level below switched them off; retention and attachment size are the smallest value any level states, capped by the operator's ceiling; switched-off capabilities add up across levels; extra confirmation takes the lowest threshold. The effective view is read only and is never an input to the policy gateway: what a model may use is decided from the package, the token and the host policy alone. decided_by names, for the fields that more than one level can state, which level decided the value.

levels.description: The revision of the document each level contributed; 0 means that level has no document.

language.description: The effective language, when any level states one.

model_profile.description: The effective approved model and resource profile.

allowed.description: The deployment and tenant policy allow voice.

enabled.description: Voice is allowed and the user asked for it.

store_transcript.description: The transcript may be kept and the user did not ask otherwise.

allowed.description: The deployment and tenant policy allow attachments.

enabled.description: Attachments are allowed and the user accepts uploads.
Notifications are allowed and the user wants them.

disabled.description: Capabilities switched off at any level, sorted.

extra_from_risk_level.description: Present when any level asked for extra confirmation: the lowest risk level that was asked for. The platform floor applies whether or not this is present.

decided_by.description: For language, model_profile, voice.enabled, history.retention_days, history.export_allowed, privacy.store_transcript, attachments.enabled, attachments.max_file_mb, notifications.enabled and confirmation.extra_from_risk_level: the level that decided the value.
